About me

I’m an Electrical Engineering undergraduate at Govind Ballabh Pant Engineering College, Pauri Garhwal, based in Haridwar, Uttarakhand. I led my college technical team for over two years, coordinated an Electric and Hybrid Vehicles (EV/HEV) workshop, and have completed internships in Deep Learning at NIT Kurukshetra and in orthotic and prosthetic rehabilitation engineering. I’m now seeking an Engineering Trainee position where I can apply my technical, troubleshooting and project execution skills.
